why: Actor Studio drops the subclass item itself, so the class's Subclass advancement stays unset (value.uuid null) while the hero has the subclass and its features
the Human species offers Medium or Small and the system shows Small first; the raw route leaves the choice unset, both heroes are Small
the raw builder answers only the system's advancement questions, which ask for no class spells; Actor Studio's Spells tab adds them

the system leaves the slots of a new actor empty until a long rest; upstream Actor Studio does not fill them, and the fork fills level 1 only in 2.10.5-aitool.1, so a hero levelled to 5 keeps the slots of level 1 (for example 2 of 4) while the raw builder fills all of them; fixed in 2.10.5-aitool.2 (a hero levelled up in Studio ends with every slot level and pact at its maximum)
an effect that adds to the maximum raises the maximum, not the current value

a hero levelled in Actor Studio whose Constitution modifier rises on an ability score increase ends below the maximum: the 2024 book raises the maximum by one per level, the system adds only each level's own hit points to the current value, and takes a level's hit points before its increase. Fighter 17 with a Constitution modifier of +2 up to level 11 and +3 from level 12 ends at 145 of 157 (12 more in the maximum than in the current value); fixed in the fork: a hero that was at full hit points before a level up ends it at full
a feature that spends a slot cannot run on a hero with empty slots
Actor Studio 2.10.5 throws a jQuery selector error (dnd5e-checkbox[aria-label*="average" i]) on every advancement dialog when take average hit points is on
Actor Studio asks for an asset under a doubled path (404)
